subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `capabilities.tts.voice.captionedFinalText` as a public channel capability and enable it by default for bundled Telegram final-mode TTS after the ACP cancellation bug is fixed?
rationale: This PR is not only a bug fix; it expands the plugin-facing channel contract and changes Telegram's default final-mode TTS delivery while a related open issue asks for a separate text-plus-voice delivery option.

options.title: Accept capability after fix
options.body: Repair the ACP cancellation blocker, then treat captioned final TTS as the default Telegram fix and leave separate delivery to the existing product issue.

options.title: Require explicit delivery mode
options.body: Ask for a default-preserving config or policy shape before merge so existing users can choose captioned versus separate text and voice behavior.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Do not merge the public capability yet and keep #83511 open until maintainers settle the Telegram TTS delivery model.

recommendation.title: Accept capability after fix
recommendation.body: Repair the ACP cancellation blocker, then treat captioned final TTS as the default Telegram fix and leave separate delivery to the existing product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points most strongly to steipete for the TTS channel capability and Telegram delivery contract decision.
